title: The Choir of the Undercroft
author: Beatrix Nakamura
blurb: Coral Lockridge, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
